CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.lg_platform_country(p text)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select case p when 'SUPERLG' then 'PH' when 'LGPARTY' then 'PH' when 'LGSABONG' then 'PH'
 when 'LGBIGWIN' then 'PH' when 'LG111' then 'ID' when 'LG789' then 'PK' end
$function$
;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.lg_country_timezone(c text)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select case c when 'PH' then 'Asia/Manila' when 'ID' then 'Asia/Jakarta' when 'PK' then 'Asia/Karachi' end
$function$
;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.lg_is_owned_report(r jsonb, is_third boolean)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select public.lg_platform_country(upper(r->>'platform')) is not null
 and case public.lg_platform_country(upper(r->>'platform')) when 'PH' then '菲律宾' when 'ID' then '印尼' when 'PK' then '巴基斯坦' end = r->>'country'
 and case when is_third then
 coalesce(r->'raw'->>'system',r->'raw'->>'system_name','LG')='LG'
 and (r->>'sheet_name'='LG_DIRECT' or r->>'sheet_name' ~ '^\[三方量表[12]\] raw_[0-9]{4}_[0-9]{2}_代[收付]$')
 else coalesce(r->'raw'->>'system',r->'raw'->>'system_name','')='LG' end
$function$
;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.lg_valid_scopes(scopes jsonb)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select case when jsonb_typeof(scopes)='array' then jsonb_array_length(scopes)>0 and not exists(
 select 1 from jsonb_array_elements(scopes) s where public.lg_platform_country(s->>'platform') is null
 or public.lg_platform_country(s->>'platform') is distinct from s->>'country_code') else false end
$function$
;
